source.title: extra-eyes delivery queue and IPC cargo test pass

acquisition.details: Ran `cargo test` after adding daemon IPC requests `enqueue_message`, `fetch_messages`, and `commit_cursor`. Result: 14 unit tests passed and 12 integration tests passed. New coverage includes durable message/cursor restart recovery, monotonic message ID continuation after restart, fetch-without-commit retry behavior, commit-after-success suppression, monotonic cursor commits, future cursor commit rejection, channel isolation, cursor isolation, empty/small/128KB socket payload round-trips, boundary-size frame write/read, zero/oversize/malformed frame rejection, and a fixed large-frame bug where accepted Unix streams inherited nonblocking mode from the listener.
